name: io.github.77systems-ai/receipts
description: Verification for every AI agent: destination receipts, package binding, and retry laws.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_AUDIT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local append-only audit JSONL path. Defaults to .receipts/audit.jsonl in the process working directory.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_GITHUB_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Exact GitHub owner/repo for independent issue read-back. Omit for cooperative-only use.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Local GitHub token authorized to read the configured repository. Sent only to the GitHub API for authentication.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_POLICY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local JSON WritePolicy applied at claim and dispatch. Host-owned startup configuration; no tool call can change it. Omit to permit registered surfaces.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_CLAIM_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Positive integer TTL in milliseconds for unused claims. Dispatched claims never expire into another write. Defaults to the core registry default.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPTS_SIGNING_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local 0600 PEM PKCS8 Ed25519 private key whose contents never leave the machine. Enables receipts.sign and receipts.badge; omit to keep signing disabled.
